subgoals.title: 検証済みGoalの実行結果を安全なJSONに書き出す
acceptanceCriteria: Implement a Node.js standard-library-only command that exports reviewed goal statuses and compact evidence summaries to a local JSON feedback file without invoking Codex or any network API.
Exclude local absolute paths, credentials, environment values and raw model output; identify CODEX_EXECUTION and LOCAL_IMPLEMENTATION evidence accurately without claiming automatic human approval.
Add focused tests for reviewed PASS, local implementation PASS, missing review evidence and sensitive-data redaction; keep the existing regression tests passing.
